records.title: Government Functional Standard GovS 008: Commercial, version 2.2
records.date_note: HTML states Updated 14 May 2026 and describes v2.2 replacing v2.1 after spending-control reforms.
records.population: Government commercial activity within the standard’s specified public-sector scope; not payroll-only or private-employer data.
records.limitations: Normative public-sector standard. Internal schemes of delegation still matter. Do not apply central-government approvals, public procurement rules or mandatory roles to private employers; do not treat expert advice as final approval.
records.reuse_status: Private verification; paraphrase and rights review required before final client reuse

records.title: Government Functional Standard GovS 006: Finance, version 3.1
records.date_note: PDF cover says Date issued 31 July 2024. Landing page says Version 3.1 July 2024 but still carries 11 May 2023 last-update stamp; do not misdate the document to that stamp.
records.locator: PDF cover p1; scope section 1.2 printed p2/PDF p6; 4.4.4-4.4.7 printed pp15-16/PDF pp19-20 (one-based).
records.population: Government departments, arm’s-length bodies, some public corporations and other entities as specified in section 1.2; no empirical sample.
records.limitations: Specific public-sector finance roles; not evidence of private-employer practice, a universal CFO veto or current policy for every public body. PDF issue date is 2024; its relationship to newer spending-control reforms must remain scoped, with GovS 008 v2.2 used for the current commercial distinctions reviewed.
